name: Mirrortech Demo RWA
assumptions: Demo economics: one token represents one mock USD, using six decimal places.
Demo maximum outstanding supply is 1,000,000 tokens; the agreement does not specify this cap.
The backend wallet holds all tokens; an off-chain ledger records beneficial investor balances.
Transfers are disabled for this MVP, including the P2P transfers described in the agreement.
Issuer authorization, offering compliance and redemption authorization are operator attestations.
KYC, AML, sanctions screening and fiat settlement are simulated. No real assets are represented.
